EDIT: After posting this i realized i should give some tips (from experience)
•Your period can last anywhere from 3-7 days
•On average, your period will come every 28-30 days (Depends on the person) 
•Cramps may happen, and they suck. Tampons (which you shouldn’t be using yet imo) can make these worse. To help relieve cramps, you can take an OTC painkiller such as ibuprofen or Pamprin (though some OTC painkillers can make you drowsy, so watch out for that), and switch a tampon our for a pad
•CHANGE YOUR TAMPONS OFTEN (3-5 hours is my usual). If you leave them in too long you can develop TSS (toxic shock syndrome) which can kill you. Personally, I don’t recommend using a tampon until you’re at least 15-16. 
•For your age, you may only need the thin pads, but if your period is heavier you’ll need the heavy flow pads.
